title: Design a notification service
statement:
Product teams across the company want one service that sends notifications to users by push, email and SMS: order updates, security alerts and marketing campaigns. Teams call your service; it decides how to reach each user according to their preferences and delivers the message through third-party providers.

Clarify or state any other requirements and assumptions you need, then walk through your design.
facts: 50 million users; on average 20 million notifications per day, and campaigns of up to 10 million notifications at once.
Security alerts, such as a password change, must arrive within 30 seconds.
Users can opt out per channel and per category, and marketing must respect each user's quiet hours.

keyPoints.text: accepts notification requests through an API and puts them on a queue, so senders are never blocked by delivery
keeps separate queues or priorities so a 10-million marketing campaign cannot delay security alerts
checks preferences, opt-outs and quiet hours before sending, from a preference store with caching
delivers through workers per channel that call the providers (APNs or FCM, email, SMS) with retries and backoff
makes sending idempotent with a notification id, so a retry never notifies a user twice
handles provider failures and rate limits with circuit breakers, a second provider and a dead-letter queue
tracks the delivery status of each notification for debugging and metrics
uses templates and per-user limits so users are not flooded with notifications

probes.MESSAGING: A marketing campaign enqueues 10 million notifications at once. How do security alerts still arrive within 30 seconds?
probes.RELIABILITY: A worker crashes after calling the SMS provider but before recording the send. What happens, and can the user get two text messages?
probes.FAILURE_HANDLING: Your email provider starts timing out for 20 minutes. What does the system do?
probes.DATA_MODEL: How do you store user preferences and the delivery history? SQL or NoSQL, and why?
probes.OBSERVABILITY: How would you find out that push notifications to Android users silently stopped arriving?
probes.API_DESIGN: What does the API look like for a team that wants to send a notification?
